messages:
Jules: heads-up: v5.3.2 started rolling five minutes ago. deploy-bot just flagged a spike in streaming timeouts on hosted canary. filing here for a quick decision.

deploy-bot: [AUTOMATED ALERT] hosted/call-stream: timeout_rate 0.9% (baseline 0.1%, threshold 0.4%) -> recommended action: auto-revert to v5.3.1.

Ava: seeing `stream_timeout` traces from ingress1-3; looks correlated with new keepalive tuning. dedicated pools clean.

Ben: we have a change freeze for enterprise customers in 2h. I don't want an org-wide auto-revert that could break the planned window. suggest a scoped rollback for hosted only.

Carmen: scoped rollback sounds right. Can we pin the hosted ingress deployment and steer only hosted routes back? minimal blast radius.

Rohit: plan: (1) pin ingress image for hosted to `ingress:5.3.1-stable`, (2) apply traffic-tag `hosted-rollback-531` for hosted-api route, (3) add short release_notes entry and customer blurb.

Jules: who runs the steps? Carmen take kubectl, I'll handle routing. Ava draft customer note.

Carmen: kubectl commands ready:
```bash
kubectl -n ingress set image deploy/edge ingress=redwood/ingress:5.3.1-stable --record
kubectl -n ingress rollout status deploy/edge --watch
```

Jules: routing command (rlctl):
```bash
rlctl route update --name hosted-api --set-tag hosted-rollback-531 --weight 100
```

Rohit: execute with gradual steps: 25 -> 60 -> 100% with 30s waits and health probes. deploy-bot will report each stage.

deploy-bot: action: routing change started by Jules. step1 25% applied. health checks running.

Ben: comm checklist: 1) post customer note in /customers/hosted-updates, 2) add rollback note to release_notes.md, 3) ping CSMs for top accounts. keep message simple.

Ava: draft: "We observed elevated streaming timeouts on the Hosted API after v5.3.2. We have rolled the Hosted edge back to the prior stable image to restore streaming. No customer action required; Dedicated and Private deployments are unaffected." approve?

Ben: approved. Carmen proceed. Jules proceed with routing after pods healthy.

Carmen: applied image pin, rollout progressing: 2/3 -> 3/3 ready.

deploy-bot: routing step succeeded 25% -> 60% -> 100%. metrics: timeout_rate back to baseline within 90s.

Jules: verified metrics: timeout_rate now 0.12%, p99 latency stable. Opening infra ticket INFRA-5177 to block future auto-reverts until we investigate keepalive change.

Rohit: created INFRA-5177 "Investigate ingress keepalive tuning causing hosted stream timeouts" and assigned to @networking.

Ava: posted customer blurb: https://customers.redwood/status/hosted-streaming-rollback-2024-05

Ben: thanks team. marking thread closed once release_notes updated. :white_check_mark:
